brief.topic: The Narrow Opening That Lets Light Spread

s01: A narrow opening can make a beam of light spread wider.
Here, the bright band sits between two dark boundaries.
Come closer to the pattern on a distant screen.
The light has one wavelength, and the opening is a single straight slit.
We are looking at an ideal far field pattern.
Light from different parts of the opening combines.
In the center, those contributions reinforce one another.
At certain angles they cancel, leaving dark lines.
The first dark line obeys a simple relationship.
Slit width times the sine of that angle equals one wavelength.
Keep the wavelength fixed, and make the slit half as wide.
The sine of the first dark angle must double.
Both dark boundaries move away from the center.
The central band spreads out, even though the opening got smaller.
This display normalizes the peak, so it compares shape, not total transmitted power.
Open the slit again and watch the band become narrow.
An opening does more than admit light. It helps shape where that light can go.

scenes.narration:
A narrow opening can make a beam of light spread wider. Here, the bright band sits between two dark boundaries.

Come closer to the pattern on a distant screen. The light has one wavelength, and the opening is a single straight slit. We are looking at an ideal far field pattern.

Light from different parts of the opening combines. In the center, those contributions reinforce one another. At certain angles they cancel, leaving dark lines. The first dark line obeys a simple relationship.

Slit width times the sine of that angle equals one wavelength. Keep the wavelength fixed, and make the slit half as wide. The sine of the first dark angle must double. Both dark boundaries move away from the center.

The central band spreads out, even though the opening got smaller. This display normalizes the peak, so it compares shape, not total transmitted power. Open the slit again and watch the band become narrow. An opening does more than admit light. It helps shape where that light can go.
